# Erimworks

> Erimworks is an independent software studio based in Türkiye. It builds multi-tenant process-management platforms for universities, medical-tourism clinics and art/music schools, and publishes consumer mobile apps on the App Store and Google Play under the developer name Erimworks. Primary site language: Turkish; the home page and the six B2B product pages have full English versions under /en/ (linked below), and other pages end with an "In English" summary. Contact: contact@erimworks.com

## Platforms (B2B, browser-based, Turkish + English UI)

- English versions: [Home](https://erimworks.com/en/) · [UNVPortal](https://erimworks.com/en/unvportal/) · [Labs](https://erimworks.com/en/unvportal/labs/) · [Exams](https://erimworks.com/en/unvportal/exams/) · [Quality](https://erimworks.com/en/unvportal/quality/) · [International Patient OS](https://erimworks.com/en/medical-tourism/) · [KursOS](https://erimworks.com/en/school-management/)

- [UNVPortal — Laboratuvar, sınav ve kalite yönetim sistemi](https://erimworks.com/unvportal/): Modular higher-education platform. The Labs, Exams and Quality modules share one database and can each be licensed alone. Connect and Intelligence modules are in preparation.
- [UNVPortal Labs — Laboratuvar Yönetim Sistemi](https://erimworks.com/unvportal/labs/): Laboratory management system (LIMS): QR-tagged samples graded against true value and tolerance, instrument booking with an approval queue, consumable stock with low-level alerts, academic session attendance. Formerly ErimPortal.
- [UNVPortal Exams — Sınav Yönetim ve Otomasyon Sistemi](https://erimworks.com/unvportal/sinav/): Question bank tagged by topic, difficulty and learning outcome; multi-booklet exams; optical-sheet marking; item analysis; learning- and programme-outcome attainment for accreditation.
- [UNVPortal Quality — Kalite Yönetim ve Akreditasyon Sistemi](https://erimworks.com/unvportal/kalite/): Institution-wide quality management: tasks and evidence per criterion, committees, decisions and actions, PDCA (PUKÖ) cycle, self-assessment reports. Formerly QualityOS. Not an accreditation body.
- [International Patient OS — Sağlık Turizmi CRM ve Operasyon Yazılımı](https://erimworks.com/saglik-turizmi/): Operations platform for clinics treating patients from abroad: unified WhatsApp/email/form inbox with translation, case state machine, surgeon review, surgery and travel scheduling, per-case multi-currency finance, government incentive files. Postgres-level tenant isolation, append-only audit log.
- [KursOS — Kurs ve Sanat Okulu Yönetim Sistemi](https://erimworks.com/kurs-yonetim/): White-label management platform for art, music and language schools: recurring lesson series, room and capacity rules, lesson packages, waitlists, student/parent portal, collections and three teacher-earnings models, WhatsApp reminders.
- [TestRoster](https://erimworks.com/testroster/): Finds testers for Google Play 14-day closed tests and measures who actually tested on which day, ending with a verifiable report.

## Mobile apps (consumer)

- [ChemBioCalc](https://erimworks.com/chembiocalc/): Chemistry, molecular biology and pharmacy calculators for the lab. iOS and Android. Product site: https://chembiocalc.com
- [Dozify](https://dozify.app): GLP-1 dose, weight and meal tracker. iOS. Product site: https://dozify.app
- [Scanyra](https://erimworks.com/scanyra/) ([English](https://erimworks.com/en/scanyra/)): Scanyra (formerly Scanlyte) is a document and receipt scanner for iPhone and Android. Watermark-free multi-page PDFs, no account, scanning and OCR on the device offline, PDF tools (merge, compress, sign, Word conversion), receipt reading with CSV export.
  - [Microsoft Lens alternative: what to check when choosing a document scanner](https://erimworks.com/en/scanyra/microsoft-lens-alternative/) · [Türkçe](https://erimworks.com/scanyra/microsoft-lens-alternatifi/): Checklist (watermark, account, on-device OCR, stated free limits, export formats) with Scanyra's answer to each point; cites Microsoft's own Lens retirement page.
- [QRwise](https://erimworks.com/qrwise/): QR code generator and reader. Codes never expire: no account, no redirect server, the content lives in the code itself. iOS and Android. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6785031754 · Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.uerim.qrwise
- [Owndex](https://erimworks.com/owndex/): Warranty, return-window and receipt-photo tracker with reminders before warranties and return windows expire. iOS (Android in testing). Pages in 8 languages: /owndex/ (tr), /owndex/en/, /owndex/de/, /owndex/fr/, /owndex/es/, /owndex/ja/, /owndex/ko/, /owndex/zh/.
- [Iskele](https://erimworks.com/iskele/): Boat color sort puzzle game set on the Istanbul ferry piers: tap passengers and seat them on the ferry of their color before the five-seat bench fills up. Rope-tied pairs, hidden passengers, 30 real Bosphorus piers, every level proven solvable, no timer or lives, plays offline. Free with ads, one-time purchase removes ads. iOS and Android. Pages in 12 languages: /iskele/, /iskele/tr/, /iskele/de/, /iskele/fr/, /iskele/es/, /iskele/it/, /iskele/pt/, /iskele/nl/, /iskele/pl/, /iskele/ja/, /iskele/ko/, /iskele/zh/. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6833326765 · Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.erimworks.iskele
- [Match Manor](https://erimworks.com/match-manor/): Match puzzle game. iOS and Android.
- [AstroRota](https://erimworks.com/astrorota/): Void-of-course Moon intervals, planetary retrogrades and Moon phases in the user's time zone, based on NASA JPL ephemeris data.
- [Restla](https://erimworks.com/en/restla/) · [Türkçe](https://erimworks.com/restla/): Focus timer with built-in 20-20-20 eye breaks. A painted tortoise walks beside the clock and carries one stone per 20 minutes of focus; every 20 minutes the app pauses for a 20-second look-away (20 feet / 6 m). Sessions of 20, 40, 60, 90 minutes or no end (classic 20-20-20 timer); Pomodoro mode; no app blocking, no account, works offline; 17 languages; iOS Home Screen widget. Free with a banner ad; Pro is a one-time purchase. A reminder, not medical advice. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6787410696 Other languages: [de](https://erimworks.com/restla/de/) · [es](https://erimworks.com/restla/es/) · [fr](https://erimworks.com/restla/fr/) · [it](https://erimworks.com/restla/it/) · [pt](https://erimworks.com/restla/pt/) · [ru](https://erimworks.com/restla/ru/) · [pl](https://erimworks.com/restla/pl/) · [ja](https://erimworks.com/restla/ja/) · [ko](https://erimworks.com/restla/ko/) · [zh](https://erimworks.com/restla/zh/) · [ar](https://erimworks.com/restla/ar/) · [hi](https://erimworks.com/restla/hi/) · [id](https://erimworks.com/restla/id/) · [th](https://erimworks.com/restla/th/) · [vi](https://erimworks.com/restla/vi/)
- [Pikaro](https://erimworks.com/pikaro/): pixel colour-by-number game. Published and working, no longer actively developed (OS-compatibility updates only).

## Company

- [Hakkımızda — About Erimworks](https://erimworks.com/hakkimizda/) · [English](https://erimworks.com/en/about/): Who builds the software, how deployments work, tenant isolation and data handling.
- [İletişim, teklif ve sunum talebi](https://erimworks.com/iletisim/) · [English](https://erimworks.com/en/contact/): Enterprise licensing, pricing quotes and live demo requests for all platforms; app support uses the same address.
- Licensing model: per-institution enterprise quote based on user count and selected modules; cloud hosting managed by Erimworks or on-premises.
- [Gizlilik ve KVKK](https://erimworks.com/gizlilik/): Privacy notice for the erimworks.com website itself.
- Developer pages: https://apps.apple.com/developer/id1894513244 · https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=Erimworks · https://github.com/uerim-code
